text:
# Pre-market brief, Fri 2026-11-13 (as of ~8:15 AM ET)

1. **Rates are the main driver.** The 10-yr is ~5.13–5.15%, up nearly 30 bp this week (on pace for its worst week since Apr 2025), and the 30-yr is ~5.46%. FedWatch prices a Dec 9 hike at 100% (~87% for 25 bp, ~13% for 50 bp) ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/treasury-yields-fed-rates.html); [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/11/13/live-news-bitcoin-drops-below-200-week-moving-average-as-dollar-strength-pressures-risk-assets)).
2. **October PPI comes out at 8:30 AM ET.** Consensus is +0.4% m/m headline (Sept was +1.3%) and +0.3% core ([Sharecast](https://www.sharecast.com/news/market-report-us-pre-open/us-pre-open-futures-trade-higher-ahead-of-october-ppi-figures--24165708.html)).
3. **Futures are flat to slightly up.** Around 7 AM ET, ES was ~+0.2/0.3%, NQ ~+0.25%, Dow ~+0.17% (Sharecast). Earlier, Reuters had NQ roughly flat ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-dip-as-nvidia-tumult-keeps-investors-on-edge-5024713)).
4. **NVDA is up ~2–3% pre** after Huang's exit. Kress is interim CEO and an outside firm is searching for a successor. Earnings are 11/17 AMC. AMD and AVGO are down >1.5% pre ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-modine-surges-cerebras-jumps-on-microsoft-deal-5024934); Reuters).
5. **MSFT is down ~1–2% pre** after an outage of 12+ hours across Outlook, Teams, and Copilot (Reuters; [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)).
6. **CSCO is down ~2–2.7% pre** despite its beat and raise. Non-GAAP gross margin was 65.6% vs 68.1% a year ago. The after-hours gain did not hold, so the conditional idea is off unless the close reverses (Investing; [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/futures-edge-lower-nvda-fallout-110121361.html)).
7. **Gaps above 5%, skipped per the gap rule.** CBRS is +16–17% on a Q3 beat, a raised 2026 guide, and a Microsoft deal (it is also in the AI-hardware theme). MOD is +30% on a Bloomberg report of Samsung takeover talks (CNBC; Investing).
8. **Other cross-asset moves.** BTC is ~$68–69k, a 3-month low below its 200-wk MA, and COIN/MSTR/MARA are down 1.4–2.6% pre. Brent is ~$96 and WTI ~$88.7. DXY is >103 (CoinDesk; Reuters; Yahoo).

**Earnings in the next ~10 days:** NVDA, HD, and DIS on 11/17; TJX, LOW, TGT, and PANW on 11/18; WMT and INTU on 11/19 (from the existing calendar). No major reports today (Sharecast).

**Swing idea (long-only):**
- **PANW**: KeyBanc upgraded it to Overweight with a $380 PT, citing AI-security budget growth and a 20% pullback in a month. It is up ~3.5% pre, below the gap limit (CNBC). Confidence: low. Key risk: earnings 11/18 AMC with an upgrade-only catalyst, and a 10-yr above 5.1% hurts growth multiples.
- No other new longs. AI-hardware group avoid stays through 11/18.
